# SabahWebs

> SabahWebs (Happy Codes) is a web design and SEO agency based in Sabah, Malaysia. Run by two partners, Bing and Liang, we build fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites and provide honest, results-focused SEO for businesses in Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan, Tawau and across Sabah — plus selected clients in Australia.

## About
- Business: SabahWebs (also known as Happy Codes)
- Type: Web design & SEO agency / service-area business
- Founders: Bing & Liang
- Service areas: Kota Kinabalu (KK), Sandakan, Tawau, and all of Sabah, Malaysia
- Differentiators: Webflow specialists, honest/transparent pricing, SEO and AI-search (GEO) focus, no lock-in contracts
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +60 16-843 0891 · email happycodesmy@gmail.com

## Services
- [Web Design Sabah](https://sabahwebs.com/web-design-sabah): Professional, fast, mobile-first business websites from RM2,500.
- [SEO Services Sabah](https://sabahwebs.com/seo-services-sabah): Local SEO, technical SEO, content and AI-search optimisation from RM800/month.
- [Web Design Kota Kinabalu](https://sabahwebs.com/web-design-kota-kinabalu): Locally-optimised websites for KK businesses.
- [E-commerce Website Sabah](https://sabahwebs.com/ecommerce-website-sabah): Online stores with Malaysian payments (FPX, e-wallets) and local couriers, from RM6,000.
- [Webflow Website Sabah](https://sabahwebs.com/webflow-website-sabah): Faster, lower-maintenance Webflow sites as an alternative to WordPress, from RM3,500.
